version.label: Derived from MP Bhumi Vikas Rules 2012, consolidated to 6 March 2025

disclaimer: This is a rule reference, not legal advice. The building-permission clerk decides.
message:
Rule 56(1)(a) sets the front open space by "the street facing the plot", while Rule 65(2) says a plot on two or more streets is deemed to face the wider street for height.

The Rules do not state which street sets the front open space on a corner plot. Reading one applies the wider street; reading two applies each street to its own frontage. The clerk decides; plan check is not drawn for this case.
